name: q-anacleto-y-q-boby
description: Q-Anacleto y Q-Boby — Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 (EdTech)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && python -m uv sync --directory backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "python -m uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && python -m uv run --directory backend pytest -m "not slow"
